attBesluta.text: The VEVOR adjustable seam setters are perfect for home renovations. They are easy to use. The helped to hold the seams of the floor tiles in place. They feel heavy. This is an item we never knew we needed.

This is one rugged set of tools - definitely built for regular use for a long time. The main body is all metal, and the plastic and rubber parts are all very heavy duty. The knurling on the center piece that moves the ends closer or farther apart is plenty deep enough to get a good grip. Nothing I would change on this tool. Excellent quality and value for the money.

This is the 2nd one I have puchased and again Vevor has not disappointed me yet. Easy to put together and highly mobile. They package these so well that it takes longer to remove the protection than put together.
Received our table in 3 days very fast service and arrived in perfect condition! very sturdy table very pleased with our purchase! Thank You
